limits: coupled space/time refinement, not isolated mesh convergence
fixed bottom not validated Coulomb runout bed
adapted geometry not exact Xie foundation
localization/observer sensitivity and near-critical duration remain unresolved
formal static negative normals are not dynamic validation
Motion thresholds are diagnostic conventions, not universal failure criteria.
Fine native h-scaled cohort/detector is not substituted for the fixed metre observer.
Initial1m bin history distributions are not measured shear-band width or damage.
Current-state and saved-interval checks do not certify unsaved states or calibrated runout.
